# Copilot project entry point

This is the planning foundation of Neighborhood Defense, a novice family game project. No engine project or gameplay build exists yet.

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md). Then read [current status](../docs/STATUS.md), [active directives](../docs/coordination/AI_DIRECTIVES.md), [backlog](../docs/coordination/BACKLOG.md), and [conversation index](../docs/conversations/README.md). Resolve these paths from this file, or use their repository-root paths when your tool requires that.

Record actionable requests, project responses, directives, and handoffs in Markdown. Preserve proprietary rights and mark proposals as proposals. Use a task branch, a separate session record, and appropriate checks. Do not claim a game test ran when only documentation exists. This adapter routes to canonical policy rather than duplicating it.
